title: Determine and repair Port Authority clock fixture timing
what: Diagnose the approved archive's clock-reversal failure using private phase-specific fixtures and repair only its ambiguous test, without installing supporting runtime controls.
why: The owner-approved added focused workload exercises the packaged runtime in private fixtures alongside existing gate and regression checks.
coverageEvidence: docs/validation/unified-tiers.json test-fast: gate-unit, regression-guard, port-authority-clock; pnpm run test-fast -- GENERATED_ID; 60000ms step, 120000ms total, 5000ms cleanup.
done: Recorded archive evidence is distinguished from fresh focused proof and full-package acceptance.
Forced startup expiry reproduces exit 4, rejects the old exit-1 assertion, confirms stopped owned work and retained exclusion.
Dispatched reversal requires exit 1 and quiescent release; independent queue reversal requires exit 3 and no dispatch.
The original archive and canonical supporting package remain untouched; repaired private test snapshot is retained.
outOfScope: Installing canonical supporting package files, enabling live controls, app process changes, deployment and production access.
Full 75-test package acceptance, host activation and repeated runs until passing.
steps: Add the explicitly approved focused gate workload as gate maintenance, without editing existing ledger bindings.
Provision a sealed task using the revised workload and validate its plan through the supported route.
Run the bounded tier once, preserve raw case evidence and repair only a diagnosed fixture defect.
Document observed cause, phase-specific assertions, budgets, retained evidence and remaining acceptance limits.

regression.covers: The clock-reversal fixture incorrectly requires a post-dispatch exit when its startup budget expires before dispatch, preventing the later queue assertion.
regression.checks: Forces the startup failure and rejects the old exit-1 assertion; independently requires exit 1 after dispatch with stopped owned work, exit 3 for queue timeout, and retained uncertain exclusion.
